अरबाज खान के बेटे अरहान खान के जन्मदिन पर फैमिली ने लुटाया बेहिसाब प्यार! 😍

रविवार को Malaika Arora और Arbaaz Khan के बेटे Arhaan Khan ने अपना 24वां जन्मदिन मनाया। इस खास मौके पर मां Malaika, पिता Arbaaz और सौतेली मां Sshura Khan ने सोशल मीडिया पर प्यार भरे पोस्ट शेयर किए। 🎂

Sshura Khan ने Sipaara के साथ Arhaan की कई तस्वीरें शेयर करते हुए लिखा कि उन्होंने Arhaan को एक शानदार भाई के रूप में देखा है और उन्होंने ऐसा स्टैंडर्ड सेट कर दिया है कि Sipaara कभी इससे कम पर समझौता नहीं करेगी। 😂

इसके जवाब में Arhaan ने बहुत प्यारा कमेंट किया कि 'अक्खा फैमिली एक तरफ, Sipaara एक तरफ।' Arbaaz Khan ने भी अपने बेटे के लिए लंबा नोट लिखकर कहा कि उन्हें अपने बेटे पर गर्व है और वह हमेशा उसके साथ खड़े हैं। ❤️

वहीं Malaika Arora ने भी अपने बेटे के साथ अनसीन तस्वीरें शेयर करते हुए लिखा कि उनके लिए पहाड़ों जैसी कोई ऊंचाई भी मुश्किल नहीं है और उन्होंने अपने बेबी बॉय को जन्मदिन की बधाई दी। ✨

आपको Arhaan Khan का यह क्यूट रिएक्शन कैसा लगा? नीचे कमेंट करके जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Sshura Khan praises stepson Arhaan Khan for being ‘incredible’ big brother to Sipaara, says he has set the bar high
ctx.summary: Arbaaz Khan, Malaika Arora and Sshura Khan shared heartfelt birthday wishes for Arhaan Khan as he turned 24.
ctx.text:
Arhaan Khan, son of Malaika Arora and Arbaaz Khan , turned 24 on Sunday and received heartwarming birthday wishes from his family. His father, Arbaaz, mother, Malaika and stepmother, Sshura Khan, took to social media to share special posts for him. Sshura praised Arhaan for being an incredible brother to his step-sister Sipaara.
Sshura shared a series of pictures featuring Arhaan and his little stepsister, Sipaara. The first picture showed him playing with the toddler, with her toys scattered around them. Another adorable picture captured him holding Sipaara's tiny hand. The remaining pictures showed Arhaan sharing warm moments with his father, Arbaaz and Sshura.
In her caption, Sshura praised Arhaan for being a doting big brother and wrote, "In the years that I’ve known you, I’ve admired the wonderful son and incredible friend you are, but watching you as a big brother has been a whole new discovery…!! You’ve set the bar so high that Sipaara might never settle for anything less..! 😂 She’s one lucky little sister, and you’re one in a million. All our love, always❤️❤️ Happy Birthday, Arhaan❤️🤗 @iamarhaankhan."
Arhaan had a rather cute response to her post. Reflecting his special bond with his little sister, he commented, "Akkha family ek taraf, sipaara ek taraf (While family on one side and Sipaara on one side)."
Arbaaz also shared a long birthday note for his son, expressing how proud he is of the young man he has grown up to be. Sharing his wishes, he wrote, "Happy 24th Birthday, Arhaan ❤️🎉 24 years of loving you, 24 years of being proud of you, and a lifetime of standing by you. I may not tell you every day, but I want you to know how proud I am of you. Being your father is one of the most beautiful roles life has given me. Today, as I see you growing into a mature, confident and wonderful young man, my heart is filled with pride and gratitude. Keep dreaming big, stay humble and always believe in yourself. I wish you courage to chase your dreams, strength to overcome challenges and wisdom to make the right choices. Always remember that no matter how old you get, you will forever be my little boy. Proud to be your father. Love you always!"
Malaika also celebrated her son's special day by sharing unseen pictures with him. Expressing her love for him, she wrote, "Ain’t no mountain high enuf to climb ….. my baby boy happy birthday . Love you the mostest ❤️❤️❤️ @iamarhaankhan"
A post shared by Malaika Arora (@malaikaaroraofficial)
Arbaaz Khan was previously married to actor Malaika Arora. The couple tied the knot in 1998 and welcomed their son, Arhaan Khan, in 2002. After 19 years of marriage, they finalised their divorce in 2017. Arbaaz later married makeup artist Sshura Khan on December 24, 2023. The couple welcomed their first child together, a daughter named Sipaara, in October 2025.
